hook: Ball sitting down in thick rough? Stop swinging like it's the fairway.
beats: The grass grabs the hosel and shuts the face fast.
Open the face at address so the rough can't slam it closed.
Set 60% on your lead foot and hit steeply down on it.
Grip tighter and pick a club with loft to escape clean.
Take your medicine, get it out, live to swing again.
